46/S0.subgoal: Explain why participant selection in experiment design requires a representative user profile.

46/S1.subgoal: Explain how to choose the number of participants and representative tasks for an empirical experiment.

46/S2.subgoal: Explain within-subject and between-subject designs and how to reduce practice effects in task assignment.

46/S3.subgoal: Explain why empirical data must be tested for statistical significance before drawing conclusions.

46/S4.subgoal: Describe how to select an appropriate parametric or non-parametric statistical test for an experiment.

46/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part.
